description_en: Queries the private pool information matched by instances, such as the matching mode and private pool ID
description_zh: 查询实例匹配的私有池信息，例如匹配模式、私有池ID等
name: DescribeInstanceAttachmentAttributes

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the elasticity assurance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 弹性保障服务所属地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 instance IDs. Separate the IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the instance status list.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态列表的页码。

起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for the paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

Instance.description_en: The collection of private pool information matched by instances
Instance.description_zh: 实例匹配的私有池信息组成的集合

items.description_en: The private pool information matched by an instance
items.description_zh: 实例匹配的私有池信息

PrivatePoolOptionsId.description_en: The private pool ID. If the value of `PrivatePoolOptionsMatchCriteria` is `Open`, the private pool ID is the ID of the private pool that is automatically assigned by the system
PrivatePoolOptionsId.description_zh: 私有池ID。当`PrivatePoolOptionsMatchCriteria`返回值为`Open`时，私有池ID为系统自动匹配时所分配的私有池ID

PrivatePoolOptionsMatchCriteria.description_en:
The private pool matching mode of the instance. Valid values:

Open: open mode. The instance automatically matches open private pools.
Target: specified mode. The instance matches a specified private pool.
None: none mode. The instance does not use private pools
PrivatePoolOptionsMatchCriteria.description_zh:
实例的私有池匹配模式。可能值：

Open：开放模式。实例自动匹配开放类型的私有池。
Target：指定模式。实例匹配指定的私有池。
None：不使用模式。实例不使用私有池

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the instance status list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for the paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that match the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的记录条数
